Wormwood (Artemisia absinthium)

Remedy wormwood antiparasitic bitter digestive artemisinin

Evidence: traditional

Summary

Bitter herb with artemisinin content, effective against parasites and supports digestive function.

Indications

  • parasites
  • digestive-stimulant
  • bile-flow
  • liver-support

Contraindications

  • pregnancy
  • severe-liver-disease
  • seizure-disorders

Preparations

  • tincture
  • capsule
  • tea

Body Systems Affected

  • digestive
  • liver
  • immune

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Parasitic Infections
    Intestinal parasitic infections causing digestive distress and nutrient malabsorption.
  • Respiratory Congestion
    Congestion in the respiratory tract due to mucus buildup, infection, or inflammation.
